import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Create a DataFrame from the given data
data = {
    'StichtagDat': ['2024-12-31', '2025-12-31', '2019-12-31', '2020-12-31', '2021-12-31'],
    'AlterV10Lang': ['30- bis 39-Jährige'] * 5,
    'KreisLang': ['Kreis 7', 'Kreis 7', 'Kreis 10', 'Kreis 10', 'Kreis 10'],
    'HundefarbeText': ['beige', 'beige', 'beige/schwarz', 'beige/schwarz', 'beige/schwarz'],
    'AnzHunde': [1, 1, 1, 1, 1]
}

df = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Convert date column to datetime
df['StichtagDat'] = pd.to_datetime(df['StichtagDat'])

# Set the style of seaborn
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Create a countplot for the number of dogs by year and color
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 6))
sns.countplot(data=df, x='StichtagDat', hue='HundefarbeText', palette='pastel')

# Add title and labels
plt.title('Number of Dogs by Year and Color', fontsize=16)
plt.xlabel('Year', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('Number of Dogs', fontsize=12)
plt.xticks(rotation=45)
plt.legend(title='Dog Color')

# Save the plot
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png')
plt.close()
